title: Bound on a running maximum
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{N}$, and let $B \in \mathbb{N}$. For any finite list $L$ of elements of $\alpha$ and initial value $a \in \mathbb{N}$, if $f(t) \le B$ for every $t \in L$ and $a \le B$, then the value obtained by folding the operation $(u,t) \mapsto \max(u,f(t))$ over $L$, starting from $a$, is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every list element has $f$-value at most $B$
The initial accumulator is at most $B$
